data.title: Health insurer rejects co-payment exemption for 2025
data.summary: Allgemeine Musterkasse rejected your application for exemption from co-payments (Zuzahlungsbefreiung) for 2025, dated 20 December 2024. Your co-payments did not reach the 2% burden limit of €748.20.
data.explanation: Your health insurer says your co-payments were below the personal burden limit (Belastungsgrenze), so you are not exempt from co-payments for 2025. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or record it at the insurer's office. The app shows until when. The letter says a decision sent by ordinary post counts as delivered on the third day after posting. If you are unsure, consider asking the insurer or a counselling service.

key_facts.label: Burden limit (Belastungsgrenze)
key_facts.quote:
Die Summe
Ihrer Zuzahlungen hat die Belastungsgrenze von 2 % der jährlichen Bruttoeinnahmen
(748,20 €) nicht erreicht (§ 62 SGB V).

items.title: Objection against rejection
items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or record it at Allgemeine Musterkasse.
items.consequence: After the deadline the rejection becomes final.
items.quote:
Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich
oder zur Niederschrift bei der Allgemeinen Musterkasse erhoben werden.
